title: Fix KEV entries marked forensic triage in 3 days and check for compromise
summary: CISA's BOD 26-04 'Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk' (issued 2026-06-10) replaces BOD 22-01 and BOD 19-02. KEV status is now one of four SSVC-style factors (exposure, KEV status, exploit automation, technical impact) that set graduated deadlines. KEV entries now cite BOD 26-04, and some carry a '& forensic triage' marking: remediate or mitigate within three days and carry out a forensic triage. VULN-2 treats every KEV entry as Critical (7 days) and never asks whether the flaw was already exploited, so a patched-but-compromised system can be closed as fixed. The directive binds US federal agencies only; this amendment borrows its stricter timeline and compromise check for the subset CISA itself flags.

amendments.append: A KEV entry that CISA marks for forensic triage (BOD 26-04) is fixed or mitigated within 3 days, and each affected deployment is checked for signs of exploitation since the flaw's KEV date before the finding closes; any sign of compromise starts the REL-3 incident process.

recommendation.why: Apps using the standard stop treating a patched but possibly compromised system as fixed, for the small set of KEV entries CISA flags as needing forensic triage. The main risk is cost: a 3-day deadline and a log review are demanding for a small team, and CISA's table of tier deadlines was not read (it is an image), so only the 3-day forensic-triage tier is relied on.
